more_info.overview: Penicillin G potassium is the potassium salt of benzylpenicillin. It belongs to the penicillin antibiotic family and is a different salt preparation from penicillin G sodium, procaine or benzathine. This entry preserves a historical antimicrobial designation. The general description concerns a medicinal compound and does not establish a typical current application as an ingredient added to human food.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
EU Regulation 1831/2003 ended feed-additive use of antibiotics other than coccidiostats and histomonostats from 1 January 2006; this rule concerns feed additives and does not itself prohibit authorised veterinary treatment.
